key_insight: Scale-aware composite forcing targets intermediate scales and strengthens forward energy transfer in lattice Boltzmann simulations of homogeneous isotropic turbulence.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers finer control of turbulent energy distribution than large-scale forcing alone, provided small-scale resolution remains adequate.
method: Sustain turbulence with large-scale random forcing.
Extract an intermediate-scale velocity field using composite filtering.
Apply feedback aligned with the filtered velocity and vary its strength.
evidence_signal: At approximately matched dissipation rates, 5% feedback yields a 32.36% target-band energy fraction versus 27.55% for enhanced large-scale forcing, with post-transient forward flux across K = 12 generally 2.17–2.39 times larger.
watch_item: Mean k_maxη falls to 1.01 at 5% feedback and 0.90 at 7%, indicating an approaching resolution limit and potential under-resolution.
paper_title: Scale-aware composite forcing enhances forward energy transfer in lattice Boltzmann simulations of forced homogeneous isotropic turbulence
